tasks.label: stop: api server (v06, :8082)
args: $pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8082 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($pids) { $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output Stopped_API_process_on_8082; Write-Output $pids } else { Write-Output No_listening_API_process_found_on_8082 }

tasks.label: stop: vite server (v06, :5173/:5174/:5175)
args: $ports = 5173,5174,5175; $pids = @(); foreach ($port in $ports) { $listening = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($listening) { $pids += $listening } }; $pids = $pids | Select-Object -Unique; if ($pids) { $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output Stopped_Vite_process; Write-Output $pids } else { Write-Output No_listening_Vite_process_found_on_5173_5174_5175 }
